params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor`. Omit for the newest page.

params.name: symbol
params.description: Filter to articles that mention this ticker. US equities use the bare symbol (`NVDA`); cryptocurrencies use the `<SYM>-USD` form (`BTC-USD`), and a bare crypto name resolves to it (`DOGE` matches `DOGE-USD`); foreign listings use the Yahoo suffix (`VOD.L`). A delisted symbol returns its news history. A renamed company's current ticker also matches articles tagged with its former ticker, and any share class of an issuer matches articles tagged with its other listed classes (`GOOGL` includes rows tagged `GOOG`); article tags stay as published.

params.name: category
params.description: Keep only these categories. Accepts a single value, a CSV list (`category=earnings,insider`), or a repeated parameter — matches any of them (OR).

params.name: exclude_categories
params.description: Drop these categories from the feed. Same single / CSV / repeated forms as `category`.

params.name: min_relevance
params.description: Override the default ≥4 threshold.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Items per page, default `10`. Any value from `1` to `20` is accepted on every tier; `21`-`50` requires a Pro key. A value outside `1`-`50`, or an over-`20` page without a Pro key, returns 400 — the page is never silently clamped. Pagination is otherwise unchanged: pass each response's `next_cursor` back as `cursor` regardless of page size.

params.name: collapse
params.description:
`story` collapses coverage of one event to a single representative row (the story root): syndicated reprints and independently written articles about the same event, matched on headline and lead similarity. Populates the `story_id`, `sources_count` and `sources` fields on each item. Omit for the full feed (every article, story fields `null`). Only `story` is accepted; any other value returns 400.
Note: row-level filters (`symbol`, `category`, `min_relevance`) apply to the story's representative root, so a story whose root does not match the filter is omitted entirely.

params.name: sort
params.description: `published` (default) is the reverse-chronological feed. `ingested` is delta-polling mode: rows in the order they became available, ascending, with `next_cursor` always returned (empty `results` = caught up) — see the endpoint description. All other filters apply unchanged in both modes. Cursors are mode-specific: a cursor is only valid with the sort mode that issued it (a mismatch returns 400).

params.name: min_relevance
params.description: Override the default ≥4 threshold. Insider rows score deterministically from the event's summed dollar value (plus buy/10b5-1 modifiers), so this acts as an "only large trades" dial — e.g. `min_relevance=7` keeps roughly $10M+ events.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Items per page, default `10`. Any value from `1` to `20` is accepted on every tier; `21`-`50` requires a Pro key. A value outside `1`-`50`, or an over-`20` page without a Pro key, returns 400.

params.name: sort
params.description: `published` (default) is the reverse-chronological feed. `ingested` is delta-polling mode, with the same contract as on `/api/news/`: rows in the order they became available, ascending, `next_cursor` always returned (empty `results` = caught up), and all other filters applied unchanged. Prefer it for watching insider activity — a Form 4 is filed days after the trade it reports, so a new event routinely lands below the newest page of the publish-ordered feed and a poller reading only the head misses it. Cursors are mode-specific: a cursor is only valid with the sort mode that issued it (a mismatch returns 400).

params.name: limit
params.description: Return at most this many symbols. Omit for the full list.

params.name: offset
params.description: Skip this many symbols from the start of the list.

params.name: search
params.description: Resolve a query to matching symbols: ticker-prefix, company-name substring, or the company's brand name where that differs from its registered name (`search=spacex` returns `SPCX`, registered as SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP). Case-insensitive; exact ticker, exact name and brand matches rank above prefix and substring matches. Useful for finding the canonical form of a name (`search=bitcoin` returns `BTC-USD`).

The complete per-ticker insider-trading payload behind
alphai.io/stock/{ticker}/insider-trades: the paginated Form 4 event
history plus everything a chart needs, in one request. One event is
a filing's whole tranche group (shares summed, the price
value-weighted, a 10b5-1 ladder is ONE event), same folding as the
feed's `insider` block.

The first page (no `cursor`) also carries the aggregates: `summary`
(3-month, 12-month and all-time windows plus the most active
insiders of the last 12 months)
